title: Tech Note: Offscreen Web Areas in v18 R3
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: WA Run offscreen area (new in v18 R3)
Formula-based onEvent callback (On Load/Unload/On End URL Loading/On URL Loading Error)

historical_commentary.text: WA Run offscreen area is a still-current, actively supported 4D command for headless web automation/scraping introduced in v18R3, and this pattern (in-memory web area, formula callback, JavaScript evaluation) remains fully valid; it has become especially useful as 4D's Web Area engine has since moved to Chromium, giving offscreen areas more modern and consistent JS/DOM behavior than at the time of writing.
related_updates: WA Run offscreen area remains a current, supported 4D command for headless web page processing/scraping, unchanged in core design since v18R3
4D's Web Area engine (including offscreen areas) later moved to a bundled Chromium engine, improving JavaScript/DOM consistency versus the engine available at the time of this note
The Formula-based onEvent callback pattern shown is still the standard way to handle Offscreen Web Area lifecycle events today
